title: 茶水间英文 - 11月18日 | 英伟达狂赚、万亿IPO、GTA6来了
description:
Nvidia just doubled its revenue in a single quarter, even without its famous founder at the helm, while Anthropic is about to price one of the biggest stock market debuts ever. And the most anticipated video game in years, G T A six, comes out at midnight tonight, with pre-orders already past one point five billion dollars. Plus a random question: if you had to give a surprise talk to a big crowd right now, with zero preparation, what would you talk about?

英伟达交出了一份没有创始人掌舵的创纪录财报，单季营收直接翻倍；Anthropic 则即将在今晚定价，迎来史上最大规模的上市之一。与此同时，万众期待的游戏大作 GTA 6 将在今夜午夜上线，预购额已经突破 15 亿美元。本期还有一个随机问题：如果你现在就要毫无准备地给一大群人做一场即兴演讲，你会讲什么？

Words to steal 生词本：
- blow out earnings — 财报大超预期
- after hours — 盘后交易时段
- run the show — 主持大局；说了算
- go public — 上市
- oversubscribed — 超额认购
- pre-order — 预购；提前订购
- masterpiece — 杰作；神作
- zero preparation — 毫无准备
